Materials and Methods

During optimization, a Phenyl-Hexyl (100 x 4.6 mm, 5 um) column was tested.

The selected method used a YMC-Pack ODS-AQ (150 x 4.6 mm, 3 um) column.

Eluent A: water with 0.1% formic acid. Eluent B: acetonitrile.

The flow rate was 1.0 mL/min and the column temperature was 30 C.

Results

During optimization, the standard peak had a retention time of 3.2 min.

Under the selected method, the PMP-glucose peak had a retention time of 16.7 min.
